title: Register of a cleanup state
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number and let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine. The register associated to a cleanup state is register $8$ for a state of type $pa$, register $9$ for one of type $pb$, and register $5$ for one of type $lb$.
